E.contract: HOST-PORTS-V1-r1 接受 APP-V1-05／FEAT-V1-06 的 E 環境與 P 檔案選取配對。Capabilities 持有純環境解析及既有 KlpAppPlatform／KlpAdaptiveMode 唯一宣告，Stable foundation 原 facade、型別與 current(Size?) 行為保留；application 唯一既有 host 採樣並安裝，不增加 observer、store 或預設。P 接替已接受的 concrete picker 宣告式面：公開 L1 KlpPickFileAction，port/result 套件內部；application 唯一 plugin adapter，既有 action handler 用原 frame/lease/epoch/entry 在 await 前後檢驗。有效 selected 才回呼一次，cancel/stale/failed 為 false，平台或 callback error 原物件／stack 由 host 一次回報。舊零 host picker 搬 application/legacy 並由專用 legacy root 保留 const/欄位/pick Future 成功取消與原 error 傳播；不作現行宿主 fallback。公開 roots 6→7，僅 declarative 一增一刪及新 legacy，feature exports 67→66，24 components/28 IDs/順序保持。原 R1/APP06 root/hash/closure/catalog 基準依 path-map 精確增減由獨立作者更新，不 blanket resnapshot 或放寬原守衛。E 單獨不完成 APP05；E/P 與完整證據通過才 APP05/FEAT06 complete。
E.read_exception: Read exact existing public/private interfaces and platform test factory solely to exercise real host, pure resolver, compatibility and AST boundary; no BUILD reasoning. Existing hash tests may be revised only approved exact delta, no automatic snapshots.

api.environment_canonical: KlpEnvironmentSnapshot: const value fields platform, deviceClass=desktop, orientation=landscape, displayMode=browser, adaptiveMode='', required isWebRuntime. factory resolve({required KlpAppPlatform platform, required bool isWebRuntime, double? width, double? height, Map<String,String> queryParameters=const {}}); getters effectiveAdaptiveMode/isAndroid/isWindows/isDesktop/isMobile/isTablet. Package-internal, no root export.
api.environment_adapter: Private application library part _KlpApplicationEnvironmentObserver: const constructor; KlpEnvironmentSnapshot observe({Size? viewportSize}); KlpApplicationEnvironment environment(KlpEnvironmentSnapshot snapshot) projects original private platform/accessibility/motion constructor and dispatcher flags. One host-owned instance, no additional observer or stream. _accept uses observe with original optional size, build builder calls observe with original MediaQuery size and reuses snapshot for viewport + environment.
api.stable_facade: Original KlpPlatformInfo class/const constructor/fields/getters/factory current({Size? viewportSize}) retained; samples globals only and delegates pure resolver/getters. Retain runtime !kIsWeb dependence in manually constructed getters.
api.moved_types: KlpAppPlatform is enum with original values/order. KlpAdaptiveMode is abstract final class, not enum. Both original paths reexport exact moved type via show. Existing device/orientation/display enums readonly.
api.public_action: final class KlpPickFileAction implements KlpAction { final List<String> acceptedExtensions; final void Function(String path) onPicked; const KlpPickFileAction({this.acceptedExtensions=const [], required this.onPicked}); } No pick(), host, port or dispatch API.
api.private_port: KlpFileSelectionPort.select(KlpFileSelectionRequest request) -> Future<KlpFileSelectionResult>; immutable request extensions snapshot; sealed result: KlpFileSelected(String path), KlpFileSelectionCancelled(), KlpFileSelectionFailed(Object error, StackTrace stackTrace).
api.application_adapter: const KlpFileSelectionAdapter implements KlpFileSelectionPort; sole file_selector import. Original group label assets, empty groups unrestricted, path unchanged, original error/stack -> failure.
api.session: Required internal final KlpFileSelectionPort fileSelection constructor parameter on _KlpApplicationSession, supplied by host. No public KlpApplication/runKlpApp signature change.
api.legacy: Original final KlpLocalFilePicker const constructor/fields/defaults/Future<void> pick() now application/legacy; show export only from dedicated new public legacy root. Per-call stateless adapter; success callback once/cancel none/failed Error.throwWithStackTrace; callback errors naturally propagate, never double-report via host.

supersession.R1: klp_rendering_host_boundary_test.dart whole root set/full-source hashes. E unchanged. P author adds seventh root and updates declarative hash only, preserving five other hashes and all failure privacy/borrowed ownership assertions.
supersession.APP_CONTRACT: klp_application_module_boundary_test.dart baseline roots directives + closure hashes. Author accepts enumerated environment facade additions, new private part closure, picker replacement + new legacy root. Preserve moved25 private and directive-order assertions outside exact approved delta; no blanket resnapshot.
supersession.CATALOG: klp_application_catalog_contract_test.dart lines84/93 67->66; line303 obsolete utility special case removed. Retain strict completeness/metadata/schema/24/23/1/28/order assertions, add exact removed symbol/new capability action delta.
supersession.BOUNDARY: Do not ban plugin from entire declarative implementation import graph: public application imports its private adapter legitimately. Ban plugin/upper app from capability/feature contract paths, and ban adapter/port/plugin export reachability. Keep current public authoring-negative tests.

milestones: M1 original local baseline and validRed only when behavior tested; missingAPI compilation notRed
M2 frozen hashes ARRAY and integrated checks
